The whole run took 73.868 seconds.
scenarios.expected: The replacement process resumes the original Simplified Chinese response at section 11; the steered Traditional Chinese response starts at section 1 on that same process and completes all 30 sections while the original response reaches completed.

scenarios.actual: The replacement process reclaimed the task but logged that the resilient input failed validation without a response ID and failed closed without re-invoking the handler; the response stayed in_progress. Observed with agentserver-core 2.0.0; 2.1.0 showed the same client-side outcome. The committed steering evidence therefore uses the order crash, recover, then steer.
scenarios.expected: The replacement process recovers the original response and then runs the steered turn.
